coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 7 of 11 ground-truth items (64%): all three prompting methods, all three tasks, and fixed random seeds.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies alternative A100/H100 80GB hardware instead of NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, uses three repetitions per instance instead of ten runs per task, and does not establish the required shared framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Measures latency in milliseconds with optional natural-log transformation rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time comparison nor the task-specific numerical results, including BoT being slower than Expert on all tasks and slower than PAL except on Game of 24.
